impacted_components.name: NexusDBInfo::GetSelectString / enumColumnWithNullDefault
impacted_components.reason: This changes SQL generation for enum fields so NULL outer-join values can be coerced to a concrete internal enum value and rendered/filtered as Not matched instead of blank. That affects report output and any filter path that uses the same enum select/filter helpers.

impacted_components.name: GLMatchingManager
impacted_components.reason: The GLMatching entity is graph-mapped to GLMatchingManager, and the PR changes the enum semantics for the GL matching status field on the same object. This is the primary object-level consumer of the altered matching-state behavior.

impacted_components.name: GLMatchingEditor
impacted_components.reason: GLMatching is graph-mapped to this editor path, so the changed matching-status handling can alter what the user sees when editing or reviewing GL matching records.

impacted_components.name: GLMatchingEntryManager
impacted_components.reason: The GLMatchingEntry object is part of the same matching workflow surface and is directly graph-mapped to a manager class. The PR adds null-default behavior to the matching-status enum used by this object family.

impacted_components.name: GLEntryManager
impacted_components.reason: The PR also updates the GLEntry entity definition, and the graph shows GLEntry has a REST surface. That makes the enum behavior change relevant beyond the matching-only screens because journal-entry-line data can now surface the Not matched default consistently.

missing_coverage.item: RED: no end-to-end test asserts the actual GL report or object response for a NULL outer-joined matching-status row; the new test only proves SQL string generation in NexusDBInfo.
RED: no regression test covers filter behavior for the Not matched default on real GLMatching / GLMatchingEntry data paths, only the helper and one GetSelectString case.
RED: no evidence-backed coverage for the GLEntry REST surface that graph shows is impacted, so API-level blast radius is untested.

bdd_scenarios.given: a GL matching-status field is NULL because the row came from an outer join
bdd_scenarios.when: NexusDBInfo builds the select expression for that enum field
bdd_scenarios.then: the NULL is coerced to the configured internal Not matched value and the report shows Not matched instead of blank

bdd_scenarios.given: a GL matching-status enum field has no nullivalue property
bdd_scenarios.then: the raw column is used unchanged

bdd_scenarios.given: a GL matching-status enum field is filtered in a report query
bdd_scenarios.when: the value path uses the new enum null-default behavior
bdd_scenarios.then: NULL rows are included as Not matched instead of being dropped

regression_suite.scope: NexusDBInfo SQL-generation unit tests for enum fields with and without nullivalue
regression_suite.purpose: Protect the core change that rewrites NULL outer-join enum values into a default internal status.

regression_suite.scope: GL matching report integration test for a NULL matching-status row
regression_suite.purpose: Prove the user-visible blast radius on the actual GLMatching object path, not just the helper function.

regression_suite.scope: GLMatchingEntry and GLEntry object regression tests
regression_suite.purpose: Catch side effects from the entity definition changes on the matching workflow and the journal-entry-line REST surface.
